svg.title: Handing the heater from Manual to Auto
svg.desc: After 3 seconds at 60 percent in Manual, the tracked transfer starts Auto at exactly 60 percent and recovers to 35 degrees Celsius in 23 seconds after a lowest temperature of 33.23 degrees. The untracked transfer jumps to 80.63 percent at the switch, dips less, to 33.70 degrees, and overshoots to 35.50 degrees.
svg.text: Handing the heater from Manual to Auto
Control Studio validation trials of this project · set B, β = 0.8, Tf = 1 s · 60 % in Manual, Auto at 3 s · numbers answer the predictions
